metadata.description: Claude Code plugins from lonic-software/agent-skills: session handoffs and cost accounting for long, disciplined runs.

plugins.name: phase-handoff
plugins.description: At a phase boundary the model hands off: the session clears and the next-phase prompt starts a fresh one after a cancellable countdown. Also a context tool with the handoff break-even.

plugins.name: cost-log
plugins.description: Records each turn's token usage per agent and reports cost-equivalents, heavy turns and cache rebuilds (/cost-log, cost_log tool).
